verifications.claim: Over 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's frozen fried rice and chicken shu mai are recalled as of March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Nearly 10 million pounds of Trader Joe's products... Vegetable Fried Rice... 9.8 million pounds'; R3: 'adds nearly 10 million pounds... to the 3.3 million pounds of chicken fried rice'; R5: 'additional 12 million pounds'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe nearly 10M pounds for vegetable fried rice plus prior chicken fried rice (3M+), totaling over 10M for specified Trader Joe's products in March 2026.

verifications.claim: The recall is due to potential contamination with hard plastic or glass pieces.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: All sources: 'glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide'; no mention of plastic.
verifications.reasoning: Sources unanimously specify glass contamination only; no reference to hard plastic.

verifications.claim: Affected products were produced by Ajinomoto Foods.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ajinomoto Foods North America Inc.'; R2: 'Ajimoto Foods North America Inc.'; identical across all.
verifications.reasoning: All references directly attribute production to Ajinomoto Foods.

verifications.claim: Affected products were sold nationwide except in 7 states.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2: 'distributed in 43 states'; R5: 'distributed in 43 states; the states not on the list include Hawaii, Iowa, Maine, New Mexico, South Dakota, Vermont, and West Virginia.'
verifications.reasoning: 43 states explicitly listed or implied, confirming exclusion of exactly 7 states.

verifications.claim: Trader Joe's Vegetable Fried Rice has best by dates 02/28/2026 to 11/19/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'best-by dates ranging from Feb. 28 to Nov. 19'; R2/R3: '02/28/2026 through 11/19/2026'
verifications.reasoning: Exact date range matches across multiple sources for this product.

verifications.claim: Trader Joe's Chicken Fried Rice has best by dates 03/04/2026 to 02/10/2027.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Chicken Fried Rice: Best By Dates 03/04/2026 through 02/10/2027'; R2: 'Chicken Fried Rice... best buy dates between March 5, 2026, and Oct. 23, 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: R3 supports exact range; R2 provides shorter conflicting range for the same product.

verifications.claim: Trader Joe's Japanese Style Fried Rice has best by dates 02/28/2026 to 11/14/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Japanese Style Fried Rice: Best By Dates 02/28/2026 through 11/14/2026'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match in R3; no contradictions in other sources.

verifications.claim: Trader Joe's Chicken Shu Mai has best by dates 03/13/2026 to 10/23/2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Chicken Shu Mai: Best By Dates 03/13/2026 through 10/23/2026'; R2: up to 'Oct. 23, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Exact range in R3; consistent with R2.

verifications.claim: The recall was initiated due to numerous consumer complaints regarding foreign objects.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'multiple complaints of glass'; R4: 'numerous consumer complaints about glass'; R5: 'Four customers complained of glass'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources confirm initiation via consumer complaints about foreign objects (glass).

verifications.claim: Foreign objects were identified as glass ranging from 1-3 cm in length.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All: 'glass varying in size from 1-3cm long and 2-4mm wide'
verifications.reasoning: Precise dimensions match across all sources.

verifications.claim: The glass likely originated from carrots in the products.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'carrots were "the likely source of the glass contamination"'; R4/R5: 'carrots... was the likely source of the glass contamination'

verifications.claim: The FDA lists the recall under a serious potential health consequence classification.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R3: 'Class II recall... "temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences"... chances of serious... "remote"'; R5: 'FDA... Class II... USDA... Class I (serious)'
verifications.reasoning: FDA specifically Class II (not serious); serious (Class I) is USDA classification.
